content:
The **Sacrament** is a location in the Savage Divide region of Appalachia. It is northeast of the Palace of the Winding Path and southwest of the Converted Munitions Factory.

This location is controlled by the Cult of the Mothman. It consists of a primarily wood-walled encampment with a Mothman idol in the center, surrounded by five clusters of Mothman Eggs. Directly outside the walled encampment is a locked Picklock level 3 Safe next to a single Carrot Flower bush. There are also three smaller tent-like buildings to the west with a Cooking Station.

- Nuka-Cola Cranberry - In an opened Wooden Crate below the long platform.
- Potential Vault-Tec Bobblehead - On a section of wooden railing at the top of the set of stairs leading to the long elevated wood platform, along the perimeter of the main enclosed encampment area. Look to the left immediately after climbing the stairs and before heading on to the pathway. The railing/Bobblehead is immediately next to a blue plastic crate.
- Potential Armor Mod Plan - On (or submerged on) a crate to the right of a First Aid kit below the long platform.

Sacrament appears in *Fallout 76*, introduced in the *Wastelanders* update.
